title: Section 1 — Description and history
description: Signature Shop is a mirror of the shopping kind of website: a website where a visitor browses goods, reads prices, and builds a cart. Shopping websites began as plain lists of goods with prices, then grew catalogs you could search, carts that kept a running total, and checkout pages. This mirror follows the same shape — a catalog, a cart, and a total — rebuilt with Signature branding and the network's own data.

title: Section 3 — Science proof
description: The science behind this mirror is the arithmetic of trade: a price, a quantity, and a total. A shopping website keeps a cart — a list of chosen goods with quantities — and the total is the sum of price times quantity for each line. That is all the demo does, with the mirror's own sample prices.

title: Section 5 — Spec / patent + 3D-print version
description: Spec. The Signature spec for this mirror is a draft specification for a cart calculator over a fixed sample catalog: the catalog format (name, price), the line-total rule from Section 2, the cart-total rule, and the no-payment, no-account, no-tracking design. The spec is a draft — ready to file, not filed, not a granted patent.

title: Section 6 — Demonstration programs / working prototypes
description: The demonstration on this page is the cart calculator. Type a product name and a quantity — for example, 'lantern 3' — and press the button. The page finds the product in the sample catalog, multiplies its price by the quantity, and shows the line total and the cart total.

title: Section 7 — Two AIs
description: The website AI of this mirror. It discusses the mirror, helps you browse the sample catalog in the field, explains any cart total line by line, and routes detailed questions to the website or database AI that owns the subject. It speaks in natural sentences and never presents a sample price as a real price.

title: Section 8 — USE section — use, download, copy
description: Use it: use the cart calculator at the top of this page. Type a product name and a quantity, press the button, and read the total.

title: Section 9 — Sources, codes, and network
description: Sources. The mirror's sample catalog is the network's own data, made for this mirror. The pricing rule is the mirror's own rule, stated in full in Section 2. The idea of a catalog, a cart, and a total is a general concept of the shopping kind of website, described here in general terms; no outside source is quoted as the mirror's own method.

title: 1. The Signature Shop website AI
description: The website AI of this mirror. It discusses the mirror, helps you browse the sample catalog in the field, explains any cart total line by line, and routes detailed questions to the website or database AI that owns the subject. It speaks in natural sentences and never presents a sample price as a real price.

title: 2. The AI version of the shopping
description: An AI version of the shop itself. It takes a shopping request in plain words, works out cart totals from the mirror's own sample catalog, and answers from that catalog only. It takes no payment and sells nothing, and it says so.

title: The demonstration — Product and quantity
description: Type a product name from the sample catalog, with a quantity after it if you want more than one — for example, 'lantern 3'. Separate more than one item with a comma. The demo multiplies each catalog price by its quantity and adds the lines. The catalog is a sample only; no real purchase happens on this page.
